reviewer.evidence:

The scaffold report was also used for untranslated-entry discovery and syntax parsing. No tests, builds, typechecks, or gates were run. Corrections: Translated remaining plural count labels and the thread-count announcement; corrected citation terminology and the toast count wording. Fixed the English “Close” actions, distinguished audio from voice, clarified flow connections and query operators, corrected redaction terminology, and localized GeoJSON/XML count labels. Terminology uncertainties: AI terms such as “prompt”, “embedding”, “span”, “diff”, and “retrieval” are retained or translated by context; a Malay AI/product glossary may prefer a more consistent set. Not claimed; this is an AI-assisted independent semantic review. Allowlist has 98 message paths with per-path rationales. Native-speaker certification is not claimed.
